result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: content cards are being cut off at the edges and bottom, making full restaurant names and information partially hidden from view.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off. The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all horizontal scroll content is fully visible within the viewport or provide proper overflow handling with scroll indicators

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is vertically cut off at the bottom of the screen. The full restaurant information and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing or pagination to ensure all content cards are fully visible or implement proper scrolling/pagination for the restaurant lists
